summary: Verified two frontend UI fixes in ConsultUro: (Item 3) i18n keys for the booking success 'What's next?' section — all keys (book.whatsNext, book.nextBodyInPerson, book.nextBodyOnline, book.call, book.directions) exist in en.ts, hi.ts, gu.ts with proper localized strings; book.tsx already resolves them via t() with English fallbacks so raw keys no longer appear. (Item 4) Same-patient history on /bookings/[id] is now rendered AFTER the Actions section, wrapped in a collapsible with testID bk-history-card + bk-history-toggle; default state is COLLAPSED (0 rows), tap on the header EXPANDS to reveal 3 bk-history-row-* rows, tap again COLLAPSES back to 0 rows. Chevron toggles between chevron-down (collapsed) and chevron-up (expanded). Both fixes work correctly on mobile viewport (390x844) using owner session test_session_1781800271528 against booking bk_74afa82207 with 3 sibling bookings on +919990001234.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate 'call' key inside the more:{} block of all 3 locale files (en/hi/gu) — the first 'call' at book.call is fine, but there is also more.call (Call Clinic). Not a bug, harmless duplicate namespace but noted for cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 bookings via POST /api/bookings for patient_phone=9990001234 (booking_ids: bk_74afa82207, bk_7cf77c6867, bk_eb06af06d0) on 2026-12-15/20/22 to populate same-patient-history card.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner session test_session_1781800271528 valid; booking bk_74afa82207 has 3 sibling bookings with phone 9990001234 for reproducing history-card scenarios.
rca_of_issue: Both fixes verified as correctly applied. Item 3: main agent added missing translation keys to all three locale bundles. Item 4: history block moved from mid-page to the bottom of /bookings/[id].tsx (line ~756, after the Actions card at ~728), wrapped in a TouchableOpacity toggling historyExpanded state (default false) which conditionally renders the rows.
